title: Roasted Irish Beef with Nutty Glaze
description: A hearty Irish dish featuring a tender roast beef glazed with a nutty, roasted sauce. Serve with roasted vegetables for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Irish beef roast
ingredients.notes: Choose a prime rib or top round for best results

ingredients.name: nutmeg
ingredients.notes: For adding depth to the glaze

instructions: Rub the Irish beef roast with olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Sear the beef in a hot skillet until browned on all sides.
Transfer the beef to a roasting pan and roast for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
While the beef is roasting, prepare the nutty glaze by mixing together the nutty ingredients.
After the beef has roasted for 30 minutes, brush it with the nutty glaze and continue to roast for an additional 10-15 minutes.
Remove the beef from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
